newsitem.title: USA: ARCO first quarter net up 31 percent.
newsitem.headline: ARCO first quarter net up 31 percent.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co (ARCO) said its first quarter net income rose 31 percent to $483 million, or $2.95 a share, from $370 million, or $2.26 per share a year ago on sharply higher prices and production.

"Our oil and gas business benefited from healthy prices, compared with last year's first quarter, while ARCO's West Coast refining and marketing benefited from increased margins and volume growth. These improvements more than offset reduced income from ARCO Chemical Company," said chief executive Mike Bowlin said.
The First Call consensus for first quarter earnings was for $2.68 per share and ARCO shares were up 3/8 at 134-1/4 after the earnings release.
After tax earnings at its exploration and production subsidiary surged to $452 million from $293 million.
ARCO's domestic crude liquids price averaged $18.79 per barrel, up from $14.08 per barrel last year and domestic natural gas prices averaged $2.32 per thousand cubic feet, up from $1.58 a year ago.
